title: Design Desk Note on the Design Fee Kept When a Commission Is Closed
content:
# Design Desk Note on the Design Fee Kept When a Commission Is Closed

The design fee booked to a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions is kept in full, kept in part or not kept at all when the commission is closed at the customer's request. Which of the three follows turns on the design revisions drawn on the commission and on whether a revision beyond the included allowance stands on it.

## The shares

1. Where every design revision included in the quoted total has been drawn and a revision beyond the included allowance stands on the commission, the design fee booked to the commission is kept in full, that is 100 per cent of it.
2. Where a design revision has been drawn and no revision beyond the included allowance stands, 60 per cent of the design fee booked to the commission is kept.
3. Otherwise none of the design fee booked to the commission is kept.

Every included revision has been drawn where the revisions drawn on the commission come to the number the programme includes in the quoted total or more. A revision beyond the included allowance stands where at least one of the commission's revision entries was charged as an overage.

## The programme's included revisions

| Programme | Design revisions included in the quoted total |
|---|---|
| Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting | 1 |
| Design Studio Custom Setting | 2 |
| Belrose Bespoke Design | 3 |
| Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission | 4 |
| Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission | 3 |
| Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission | 6 |

## Readings (hypothetical)

Take a design fee of USD 950.00 booked to a Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission, whose programme includes 3 revisions.

| Revisions on the commission | Share kept | Design fee kept |
|---|---|---|
| 4 drawn, one of them charged as an overage | 100 per cent | USD 950.00 |
| 2 drawn, none charged as an overage | 60 per cent | USD 570.00 |
| 3 drawn, none charged as an overage | 60 per cent | USD 570.00 |
| None drawn | — | None of the design fee booked is kept |
